title: What Does Your Dream Retirement Lifestyle Look Like?
description: Answer 12 questions to discover your ideal retirement lifestyle! From where you'll live to how you'll spend your days, find out what your dream retirement looks like.

questions.text: Where would you most like to spend your retirement years?

options.text: A beachfront villa in a tropical paradise
A cozy cabin in the mountains
An apartment in a vibrant city center
A farmhouse in the peaceful countryside
Traveling the world as a digital nomad

questions.text: What does your perfect retirement morning look like?

options.text: Early sunrise yoga on the beach
Hiking a mountain trail before breakfast
Sipping coffee at a local cafe in the city
Tending to your garden and farm animals
Exploring a new city or country

beach.title: 🏖️ The Beach Paradise Retirement
beach.description: Your dream retirement is spent in a tropical paradise! You imagine yourself waking up to the sound of waves, spending your days enjoying beach activities, and watching stunning sunsets over the ocean. Whether it's in Bali, Hawaii, or a coastal paradise somewhere warm, your ideal retirement involves sand between your toes and the ocean breeze in your hair. You value relaxation, natural beauty, and a laid-back lifestyle in your golden years.

mountain.title: 🏔️ The Mountain Sanctuary Retirement
mountain.description: Your perfect retirement is in the mountains! You dream of a cozy cabin with panoramic views, crisp fresh air, and plenty of outdoor adventures. Whether it's the Swiss Alps, the Rockies, or the Scottish Highlands, you find peace in nature's grandeur. Your ideal retirement involves hiking trails, skiing in winter, and appreciating the beauty of mountain landscapes. You value solitude, adventure, and connection with nature.

city.title: 🏙️ The Urban Cultural Retirement
city.description: Your dream retirement is in a vibrant city! You can't imagine spending your golden years away from the cultural scene, fine dining, art galleries, and endless entertainment. Whether it's Paris, New York, Tokyo, or Barcelona, you thrive on urban energy. Your ideal retirement involves attending shows, exploring museums, and being part of a dynamic community. You value culture, convenience, and intellectual stimulation.

countryside.title: 🌾 The Countryside Homestead Retirement
countryside.description: Your perfect retirement is in the peaceful countryside! You dream of a historic farmhouse, acres of land, and a self-sufficient lifestyle. Whether it's in Tuscany, the English countryside, or rural America, you value simplicity and connection to the land. Your ideal retirement involves gardening, farming, and watching the seasons change. You value tradition, family, and a grounded way of life.

abroad.title: 🌍 The Global Nomad Retirement
abroad.description: Your dream retirement has no fixed address! You envision yourself traveling the world, living in different countries, and experiencing diverse cultures. From Southeast Asia to South America, you want to be a global citizen. Your ideal retirement involves constant adventure, new experiences, and meeting people from all walks of life. You value freedom, exploration, and cultural immersion.
